newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus plans to deport Israeli prisoners.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus plans to deport Israeli prisoners.

text.p: Cyprus plans to deport three Israeli prisoners jailed two months ago for fraud and a bungled escape attempt, a prison official said on Thursday.
"They will be deported as soon as the tickets are secured and the deportation order is issued," prisons director George Anastassiades told Reuters.

David Biton, 24 and Amor Shimon, 28, were jailed for four years by a criminal court in November. The third, David Biton's brother Avi, 21, was serving a two and a half year jail sentence on fraud charges.
Anastassiades declined to elaborate on the reasons for their early release. "You will have to ask the President of the Republic or the Attorney General," he said.
David Biton and Shimon were jailed for aiding the daring escape from custody of Avi Biton and a fourth defendant, Shuki Samana, 24, in central Nicosia in early September.

Samana and Avi Biton were being taken to court in a police car for a fraud case when the other two men immobilised their police guards. They put them on the back of high-powered motorcycles and crossed a United Nations-controlled buffer zone to the north of the divided island.
There they were detained by Turkish Cypriot police who sent them back the same day. Samana received a suspended jail sentence and was released.
